definition_en: Taking the ordered quantity of a material from a storage container and putting it into the order container.
notes: Also the name of the WMS application/mode.

definition_en: Verb for performing order picking.
One pick of one order line.
A customer or internal request listing materials and quantities.
Container that receives the picked material (the target box in the app).
notes: The container the trainee fills in VR.

definition_en: Container the material is taken from (the source).
Quantity that has to be picked for the order line.
notes: Shown on the WMS screen as the label Soll.

definition_en: WMS field label for the target quantity.
notes: Keep the German label in every language mode; EN mode may show the gloss in brackets.

definition_en: Quantity actually picked; when counting by hand it is pre-filled with the target quantity.
notes: In the app (weighing, B7a) Ist grows while picking; teach it only for weighing (decision 010).

definition_en: WMS field label for the actual quantity.
Stock left in the storage container after the pick; NOT the quantity still missing.
notes: BasicPickingScene shows Rest as static remaining stock since #34 (B6).

definition_en: WMS field label for the remaining stock.
notes: Never use 'Rest' for the remainder/loose part or for 'what is missing' in feedback (german-reviewer #14).

definition_en: Counting the stock left in the storage container (F9) to confirm it.
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Confirmed quantity when actual is less than target.
Number of pieces in one carton or bag.
notes: Abbreviation VPE. A quantity, not the name of the physical package: for the object use Karton or Tüte.

definition_en: Abbreviation of Verpackungseinheit.
notes: Keep the abbreviation in both languages.

definition_en: WMS field label (abbreviation of Verpackungseinheit).

Class (0, 2–6, 8, 9) that states how a material may be picked: loose bulk (0, 2), placed one by one in order (3), touching in one/two/no layer with separators (4/5/6), ESD-protected (8), special packaging (9; 8 and 9 not without instructions).
notes: Full form: Empfindlichkeitskennzeichen (Detail Description glossary table). Classes 1 and 7 do not exist in the table.

definition_en: WMS field label; shows the EKZ class of the material (inferred from the documents, near certain).
notes: Abbreviation of Empfindlichkeitskennzeichen = EKZ; confirm with B16. Teach as "003 ist EKZ 3" (decision 010).

definition_en: Unit of count.
notes: Abbreviation ST on the WMS screen.

definition_en: Unit abbreviation for Stück on the WMS screen.
Cardboard box.
notes: Also a WMS field label.

definition_en: Plastic bag used to pack loose material.
notes: Documents also write PE-Beutel – confirm which term to use.

definition_en: Insert/compartment in a container: in the order container for pre-packing; in the storage container it holds the opened carton with the Anbruchmenge (Detail Description 5.12 photo, A13).
Loose parts that may be poured.
Quantity left over when a packaging unit is opened for a partial pick.
Order that refills stock; marked light blue at the bottom left of the WMS screen.
Separating identical-looking packs (from 8 pieces) with a bag or module.
Counting scale used from 8 pieces with low weight.
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Scale used from 700 g.
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Counting by hand (up to 7 pieces).
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Setting the scale to zero with the container on it.
notes: Also a WMS indicator and F7 button.

definition_en: Printed sticker (pick label) for a bag or position.
Confirming a pick or a message.
notes: Confirm key depends on the dialog: new dialog (TMA/CSC4) F6 Bestätigen or foot pedal, old dialog (KOM 1/2) F12 Bestätigen. In the new dialog F12 is Aufkl. korr. B8 (2026-11-01): the app uses the new dialog, F6 Bestätigen.

definition_en: Person to inform on deviations.
Identifier of a material.
notes: WMS label Mat.-Nr:

definition_en: Material description text.
notes: WMS label Bez.:

definition_en: Weight in kg.
notes: WMS label Gew.:

definition_en: Special handling instruction shown at the bottom right of the WMS screen.
Package type used in the app; meaning not yet confirmed.
notes: Question A2. Not found in any requirement document.

definition_en: Bag in which several pieces are pre-packed by the supplier (e.g. 10er Tüte).
notes: Documents also write Beutel (10er Beutel).

definition_en: Cardboard packaging of pre-packed material.
notes: Use Karton for one box.

definition_en: Product packaging box.
The goods of an order line (identified by Materialnummer), whatever their packaging.
notes: Used in feedback such as complex.feedback.wrong_package.

definition_en: Material that is not pre-packed and is picked piece by piece.
notes: Use for loose items; the unit is Stück (ST). The documents use neither Paket, Packstück nor Gebinde.

definition_en: Short identifier of a participant, P plus three digits (e.g. P017), typed on the keypad.
notes: Used as 'Code eingeben', 'Code: P017'.

definition_en: One run of the app by one participant, recorded by the research logger.
notes: Used in entry.warning.finished and entry.error.start.

definition_en: State for test codes (P000, P900-P999) whose data is not analysed.
The whole training sequence of five lessons.
notes: Course leader = Kursleitung.

definition_en: Lesson name, WelcomeScene.
Lesson name, ConceptScene.
Lesson name, BasicPickingScene.
notes: EKZ stays untranslated.

definition_en: Lesson name, MixedPickingScene.
Lesson name, ComplexScene.
Person who runs the training session and is told when the participant is done.
Auftragsposition: one line of an order (one material with its quantity).
notes: Used in lesson name '4. Mehrere Positionen'.

definition_en: The warehouse software that shows the pick order. Abbreviation LVS; write it in full with (LVS) at first use on a screen.
notes: german-reviewer (#18): the German documents say LVS, not WMS.

definition_en: Abbreviation of Lagerverwaltungssystem.
The big red physical button in VR that confirms the order. Not 'Taste' (keyboard key) or 'Schalter'.
Confirm key of the new WMS dialog (B8). The red button shows only 'F6'.
notes: In the new dialog F12 is Aufkl. korr.

definition_en: Label printed by the supplier on a carton or bag (material name, Mat.-Nr, VPE). Not 'Label', which is the pick label printed in the warehouse (F5).
WMS field label and carton label line for the material number. No dot after 'Nr'.
notes: Basic WMS shows 'Mat.-Nr:' since #17.

definition_en: WMS field label for the material description (Bezeichnung).
notes: Basic WMS shows 'Bez.:' since #17.

definition_en: Fake material name (B10, decision 007), key connector_a, Mat.-Nr 512304, VPE 50.
notes: Fake master data; capitals as in the WMS.

definition_en: Fake material name, key screw_b, Mat.-Nr 738190, VPE 20 (bag).
notes: Fake master data.

definition_en: Fake material name, key ring_d, Mat.-Nr 264857, VPE 25.
notes: Fake master data.

definition_en: Fake material name, key training_b (BasicPickingScene), Mat.-Nr 443890, VPE 50.
notes: Replaces TRAINING-MATERIAL B.

definition_en: Number of pieces, e.g. of the full cartons in a calculation (Sollmenge minus Stückzahl der vollen Kartons).
notes: 'Stück' alone only after a number.

definition_en: Full form of EKZ.
notes: Abbreviated EKZ; on the WMS dialog as Empf Kz.

definition_en: Generic word for the physical packaging of a material (carton or bag).
notes: Use when the object may be a Karton or a Tüte; for the quantity use VPE.

definition_en: One single item of a material; used in the EKZ explanations (die Teile).
notes: 'lose Teile' = loose items counted in lesson 5 (quiz, card, example); the WMS unit stays ST, Stück only after a number.

definition_en: One field of the LVS dialog (e.g. das Feld Anweisung).
Putting parts into the container without order (allowed for EKZ 0).
notes: Ask the instructor whether the warehouse says einfüllen or schütten.

definition_en: Fake material name for the ConceptScene sample order only, key stecker_c, Mat.-Nr 625417, VPE 40, Empf Kz 003.
notes: Fake master data; no package of it exists in any scene.

definition_en: One of the five lessons of the course (menu items 1-5).
notes: Not Lerneinheit/Kapitel.

definition_en: Instruction card (Aufgabe, steps 1-3) on the upright board left of the workspace (#35).
notes: Not Kärtchen/Tafel.

definition_en: A position (order line) that is picked and confirmed: Position 1 ist erledigt.
notes: Not 'fertig'.

term_en: put in one by one and in order
definition_en: How parts (in BasicPickingScene: cartons) are placed for EKZ 3; opposite of einfüllen (EKZ 0).
notes: Used in ConceptScene tour/quiz and Basic feedback (geordnet).

definition_en: Conveyor that brings the Lagerbehälter and takes the Auftragsbehälter away.
notes: Not Förderband/Band. Ask the instructor whether the site says Rollenbahn or Fördertechnik.

definition_en: Workstation where the trainee picks; plural die Kommissionierplätze.
notes: Ask the instructor: Kommissionierplatz, Kommissionierarbeitsplatz or Kommissionierstation.

definition_en: Carton already opened; loose pieces are taken from it.
notes: Not 'offener/geöffneter Karton'.

definition_en: The LVS screen at the workstation.
